data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. By default, private workspaces are inaccessible even to administrators for enhanced privacy. An admin can gain temporary access by initiating a Workspace Access Request through the Admin Console under Users, selecting the profile, and choosing Workspaces. This generates an audit log and requires a compliance override if the user is inactive. [T-3929] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
